evidence.source: 李學勤主編，《字源》 (2012), 天津古籍出版社／辽宁人民出版社, ISBN 9787552800692; PDF scan; /home/catalin/hanzi-etymology-books/research-ocr/ziyuan-full/page-1289/source.png and page-1290/source.png; directly inspected image pixels
evidence.field: PDF pp.1289–1290, printed pp.1274–1275; 巴部 headword and continuation
evidence.text: The 巴 headword gives bā, 帮纽、鱼部; 帮纽、麻韵、伯加切. Its glyph line labels the first form 《说文》小篆, followed by two 漢 forms and a 楷书 form. The account says the graph is pictographic and resembles a large snake in the 巴部; it describes the earliest displayed form as 《说文》 small seal, proposes a giant snake as the original referent, and transmits the traditional elephant-eating-snake story. The continuation on printed p.1275 says later uses such as 尾巴、下巴 and others are loans with no apparent connection to the original sense. This is the book’s attributed account, not independent paleographic confirmation; it concerns 巴 itself, not a direct claim about 吧.
evidence.title: 字源

evidence.field: 吧 entry A00520, form note and senses
evidence.text: The official Taiwan variant-character dictionary says 吧 is not recorded in 說文; its right side is 巴, with shape and writing conventions referred to 巴. It records the English loan bar in 酒吧 separately from the sentence-final particle functions. This supports a current component/form description and the distinct lexical use, but does not explain the historical formation of 吧 or date the bar borrowing.
evidence.title: A00520 吧 — 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.field: 形義通解 and 廣韻/Middle Chinese table
evidence.text: The entry identifies 吧 as 从口、巴声. It lists two Guangyun fanqie forms, 普巴 and 伯加, with Middle Chinese initials 滂 and 幫 respectively; both are level tone, 麻 rhyme, open division II. Thus 巴’s sound comparison should be scoped to 吧’s 幫-class entry, not the 滂-class entry. It separately lists modern particle functions and a Qing-novel onomatopoeic example, without dating graph formation.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 字頭「吧」

evidence.source: 江柏毅, CASE 報科學, National Taiwan University hosted article
evidence.text: Search results surfaced the author’s account of disputed oracle-bone forms formerly identified as 巴 and his argument that these forms represent a seated-person graph. The page timed out when opened, so this remains a search lead only and is not directly inspected evidence. It signals a relevant comparison to the 字源 snake interpretation but does not independently establish either account.

search_audit.query: 巴 古文字 字源 巴 甲骨文 蛇 坐人 考释; 吧 巴 phonetic component character dictionary 口 巴声
search_audit.outcome: Opened and inspected the Ministry of Education variant dictionary and CUHK 吧 entry. The CASE article URL timed out on open; search-result content was retained only as a lead, not direct evidence.

gaps: The 字源 scan confirms a 巴 headword and its continuation, not a 吧 entry. Its attributed giant-snake interpretation is relevant as one account of 吧’s phonetic component’s history, but it does not establish the component’s original referent independently or change evidence for 巴’s phonetic role in 吧.

The 字源 headword calls its first displayed form 《说文》小篆; it does not provide an oracle-bone sequence for 巴. The compared CASE seated-person reinterpretation could not be directly checked because its page timed out.
No primary facsimile of reported historical sentence-particle spellings was inspected in this invocation; the scan findings concern 巴 and do not establish 吧’s word or graph chronology.
The packet’s requested concise learner wording may be cited to official dictionary support for separate 酒吧 usage, but the historical sound basis of the English loan remains undetermined.
